manifest.title: The ball stops rising. Gravity doesn’t stop.
manifest.summary: A ball is tossed up and falls back on a fixed height scale. A motion arrow shrinks to nothing at the top while the gravity arrow never changes.
assumptions: Gravity fixed at 9.8 m/s^2, no air resistance, up is positive.
manifest.description: One ball moves up and down beside a fixed height scale with a launch guide. The blue motion arrow shortens, vanishes at the top and points down on the way back. The dashed gravity arrow stays the same.
